sections.title: Accessibility Changes
paragraphs: eLearning had originally planned to transition from our current accessibility checking software, Ally, to D2L Accessibility+, but due to unforeseen circumstances, that software development has been delayed. Instead, eLearning will be transitioning to YuJa Panorama as the accessibility replacement for Ally.

YuJa Panorama is an LMS accessibility platform that integrates directly with Brightspace to help improve the accessibility of digital media and course content. For faculty, Panorama provides color-coded accessibility scores on files as they are uploaded, giving you immediate insight into where your materials stand. When issues are found, Panorama offers step-by-step guidance and inline remediation so you can fix accessibility barriers in PDFs, Word documents, PowerPoint presentations, images, and LMS content areas without leaving the course. The platform can also automatically generate alternative formats—such as audio, ePub, Braille, and HTML—to support diverse student learning needs, and includes specialized tools for math and science content accessibility.

More information about the transition timeline, training resources, and getting started with Panorama will be shared soon. We are also planning sessions at Fall Learning Days to introduce the platform and walk through key features for faculty.

Accessibility remains a critical priority for Your Institution. Federal Title II requirements take effect next year, and institutions must ensure digital course content meets accessibility standards. Tools like YuJa Panorama are designed to help faculty identify barriers in course materials, understand accessibility status at a glance, and remediate issues before they affect students—supporting our shared responsibility to provide equitable access for all learners.
Learn more about YuJa Panorama: https://www.yuja.com/panorama/

sections.title: ReadSpeaker
paragraphs: In May 2026, Your Institution added ReadSpeaker text-to-speech tools to Brightspace. ReadSpeaker is partnered with D2L to provide lifelike online text-to-speech solutions embedded directly within the LMS—no downloads or additional software required.

ReadSpeaker webReader allows students to listen to HTML course content with a single click. As text is read aloud, words and sentences are highlighted in sync so learners can follow along. Students can customize reading speed and highlighting colors, use Text Mode for an easier reading layout, apply a Page Mask for focus, translate content, look up words, and even download an MP3 for offline listening. In quizzes, a Listen button appears on each question so students can hear assessment content without highlighting text first.

ReadSpeaker docReader provides audio playback of uploaded documents in Content, Quizzes, Discussions, and Assignments. Students can open supported files—such as PDFs, Word documents, PowerPoint presentations, and Excel spreadsheets—with docReader to listen to the content read aloud, use reading support tools like a Page Mask and Reading Ruler, highlight notes, and download them for studying.

These tools support Universal Design for Learning (UDL) by giving students multiple ways to access and engage with course materials. ReadSpeaker benefits all learners—not only students with documented accommodations—and helps the college meet accessibility requirements as we prepare for upcoming Title II standards.
About ReadSpeaker: https://community.d2l.com/brightspace/kb/articles/26721-about-readspeaker
ReadSpeaker docReader: https://community.d2l.com/brightspace/kb/articles/23766-readspeaker-docreader
ReadSpeaker for Brightspace: https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/education/brightspace/

sections.title: Course merge request form
paragraphs: A new Fall 2026 course merge request form is available. Use it when you need to combine multiple course shells into one primary course (for example, multiple sections or modalities you teach from a single shell).
Fall 2026 Course Merge Form: ZohoCourseMergewithAPIs/zohoform/26FA-Course-Merge.html

What changed from the previous form: the interface is streamlined—select a semester, choose one Primary course and up to four Merge courses from your Brightspace enrollments, then click Continue to Form to open the Zoho request (the form no longer auto-loads on every selection). Fall, Winter, and Spring 2026 terms (26/FA, 26/WI, 26/SP) appear in the semester filter. Row highlighting shows your Primary (blue) and Merge (green) choices, and the primary course cannot also be selected as a merge course. If you have issues, submit a Help Desk ticket to contact the eLearning Office.

paragraphs: Available to all faculty under Discover — check out the D2L Course Features and Resources course.

This course will walk through each component of D2L and all third-party programs that the college has to offer for a successful teaching experience. Some features include Gradebook, Activities, Creator+, YuJa, Simple Syllabus, and more. This shell will be an ongoing project.
